title: Comparison dimensions
description: The questions the comparison asks, in render order. One row per question a chooser actually has.

id.description: Stable identity. Observations reference it; renaming one orphans every observation against it.

question.description: What this row asks, phrased as the chooser's question rather than as a feature name.

why.description: Why the question is worth a row. A dimension that cannot say this is a column, not a question.
